Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing vehicles with hydraulics to operate on public roadways.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing vehicles with hydraulics to operate onpublic roadways; and adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Motor vehicles that have aftermarket hydraulic or mechanicalsystems that raise or lower the height of the vehicle are prohibitedwhile the motor vehicle is in motion on a public roadway with a postedspeed limit of twentyfive miles per hour or greater and with thevehicle speed in excess of fifteen miles per hour. At no time shallany portion of any tire leave the surface of the roadway or anycomponent of the hydraulic system cause or emit sparks. An operatorreceiving three or more citations for violating this section will berequired to remove all hydraulics from the vehicle. (2) Nothing in this section prohibits a county or city fromenacting stricter regulations for aftermarket vehicle hydraulics on apublic roadway.
